verses.1: And as for you, O man, God has not wronged you in anything; for today man is dust and ashes of the earth, and you will become wood and trees in your graves.
verses.2: And moreover Sheol will swallow you up, and those who do deeds like yours; for your teacher Siblyanos brought sin upon the head of the whole world, because he led astray our father Adam by his pride.
verses.3: For he refused to bow down to the work of his Creator, in the greatness of his heart and in the arrogance of his neck.
verses.4: And you likewise, like your teacher, have refused to bow down to the Lord your God.
verses.6: And they were condemned and went down into Sheol because of the evil deeds which they did upon the earth.
verses.7: And you also, like them, will go down into Gehenna.
verses.8: Does it seem to you that you have escaped from the hand of God? For it is His wrath and His anger, and the worship of God who gave you authority over...
verses.9: And He tested you, whether you would do His will or not; and if you make your way straight upon the earth, God will make your ways prosper, and everything you put your hand to He will make prosper, and He will bless you, and all your enemies and adversaries He will subdue for you.
verses.10: And you will rejoice in your going out and in your coming in, and in the fruit of your womb, and in your storehouses, and in your pastures; and wherever you stretch out your fingers and whatever you purpose in your heart, all of it will be granted to you; for from the bosom of God it will be given to you, so that you may do and build and plant and raise up.
verses.11: But if you refuse to hear His word and the law of the Lord, and do not walk in His ways, you will not escape from the hand of God, like all the ancients who were before you, who did not worship God in purity and did not trust in His righteous ways; for all His ways are righteousness.
verses.12: And there is nothing hidden before His eyes, and everything is revealed and manifest before Him.
verses.13: He it is who holds the dominion of kings, and who overthrows the thrones of the mighty.
verses.14: And He it is who exalts the lowly, and who raises up the fallen.
verses.15: And He it is who releases the bound, and who raises the dead, and those whose flesh has decayed and become like dust He will raise up when He wills; for mercy is with Him.
verses.16: And those who have done evil He will raise up at the resurrection of judgment, that He may requite them and repay them.
verses.17: And upon the earth He will make their seed to perish; for the law and the ordinance of the Lord are upon the ancients.
verses.18: And He does not permit sinners to enter into the counsel of the righteous; for the way of the righteous is far from the way of sinners.
verses.19: And as high as heaven is above the earth, so far is the way of the righteous from the way of sinners.
verses.20: And the way of sinners is the doing of violence and oppression, and transgression, and fornication, and adultery, and robbery, and coveting the goods of another, and drunkenness with transgression.
verses.21: And running to the shedding of blood, and destroying that which is not right, and eating the flesh of carrion, and eating blood, and eating the flesh of strangled animals, and of the camel, and going in to a woman in her impurity, and lying with her without being cleansed.
verses.22: And all these are the deeds of sinners, a broad way and the wide net of Satan, which leads into the pit and into everlasting destruction.
verses.23: And the way of the righteous is narrow and strait, which leads to life: humility and gentleness, love and peace, fasting and prayer, and purity of flesh, and abstaining from foods that are not lawful, from carrion and from what is strangled, and from fornication, and from going in to another man's wife.
verses.24: And they keep themselves from every unclean deed and from unclean foods which are not commanded in the law, and from the unclean deed which does not please God; for all these things sinners do.
verses.25: But the righteous keep themselves apart from all evil ways which do not please God.
verses.26: And He loves them and has mercy on them, and saves them from all their afflictions.
verses.27: But as for sinners, Satan accuses them, because they have not kept His law and His ordinance and all that He loves.
